definitions.explanation: the phase of the moon when it appears as a complete circle, fully illuminated by the sun

examples.japanese: {今夜|こんや}は{満月|まんげつ}だ。
{満月|まんげつ}の{夜|よる}にお{月見|つきみ}をした。
examples.english: We did moon viewing on the night of the full moon.

examples.japanese: {満月|まんげつ}が{海|うみ}を{明|あか}るく{照|て}らしている。
examples.english: The full moon is brightly illuminating the sea.

notes:
JAPANESE CULTURE:
お{月見|つきみ} (moon viewing) is a traditional Japanese autumn custom, especially during the {十五夜|じゅうごや} (fifteenth night of the eighth lunar month). People view the full moon and offer {団子|だんご} (rice dumplings) and {薄|すすき} (Japanese pampas grass).

MOON PHASES:
- {新月|しんげつ} (new moon)
- {三日月|みかづき} (crescent moon)
- {半月|はんげつ} (half moon)
- {満月|まんげつ} (full moon)

FORMATION:
{満|まん} (full) + {月|げつ} (moon) → full moon
